toolsui.subtitle: Tools and data assets AYAR manages locally, at pinned versions from official sources. Nothing downloads without your consent, and every download’s fingerprint is checked.
toolsui.note: «Verify» recomputes the installed files’ fingerprint against the catalog’s pin. «Remove» asks to confirm.
toolsui.assetFor.browser: For accessibility, the host and compatibility
toolsui.assetsNote: A data asset is updated from its check’s setup in the scan plan, with its size and destination previewed before the download.
toolsui.stale: Reference facts AYAR checked longer ago than its staleness limit ({count})
toolsui.staleNote: From AYAR’s own catalog, not from your project. They may still be right; they are shown so you know their age, and they are never updated by themselves.
